description: One anatomy serves chat, feeds, settings and search results: a leading slot, a content column, a trailing slot. A list is a menu of subjects, not the subject.

MUST: Resolve its minimum height from density, and grow rather than clip when text scales.
Take an avatar in the leading slot at the list leading size, or an icon at its role size — and inset the separator from whichever it carries.
Vertically centre the leading slot for one or two lines, and top-align it for three.
Cap the title and subtitle at two lines each, ellipsized, with de-emphasis carried by colour rather than by a smaller size.
Top-align trailing metadata with the title, and centre a trailing affordance.
Activate anywhere along the row when it is pressable, with the tint running edge to edge while the text column stays aligned.
Give an interactive trailing control its own tap and its own tab stop, with the press target stopping short of that column.
Inset its focus ring inside the row bounds — the system's one exception to painting the ring outside, because an edge-to-edge row has nowhere outside to paint.
SHOULD: Take the chevron when it navigates, and never when it toggles.
Drop one row-height step under a dense flag for pointer-first tables and pickers.
NEVER: Nest an interactive control inside the press target.
Carry both a press action and a trailing control bound to the same state — one tap runs both, and which wins depends on write order.
Ripple, flash a colour, or gain a border on press. The tint is the whole feedback.
